instruction: Activate the rulers in GIMP so I can measure parts of my image.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling rulers in GIMP. The evaluator checks the sessionrc config file for the 'show-rulers' setting being set to 'yes'. Similar difficulty to original - requires using View > Show Rulers or Ctrl+Shift+R to enable rulers display.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable GIMP rulers
Getter extracts the correct state: GIMP sessionrc config file contains ruler visibility settings
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter: receives rules dict directly from get_rule() and accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] appropriately
Metric parsing logic correctly handles sessionrc format: strips parentheses, skips comments/empty lines, matches key-value pairs
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure config changes are written to disk
Complete coverage: instruction only requires enabling rulers, evaluator checks exactly that (show-rulers: yes)
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if config file path is None
Metric supports both single-key and double-key config formats for flexibility
